notes: Stage data and the final 17-active standalone o_proj data are frozen in full, including generated weights.
The all-case run reuses build directories; earlier active-count data was overwritten by subsequent cases.
Stored data/out tensors are CPU goldens, not captured device outputs. Device comparison results are in logs.
HC-post, SWA and layer fixtures remain reproducible from model sources; their logs, not duplicate weights, are archived.
Companion patches include earlier local fixes and apply to the recorded bases; do not stack them on earlier archived patches.
Native ELF files, installed libraries and toolchains are excluded. Runtime raw device text images are included.
